deviation: The draft moves governing law and exclusive jurisdiction from New York to Illinois. Illinois is not New York and is not a neutral law, so it falls outside both the playbook position and the fallback (neutral law only with Legal approval). It also adds a carve-out letting either party seek injunctive relief in any court, which the standard does not have. This weakens Arcadia's forum control, and the carve-out lets the other side bring injunction actions elsewhere.
suggested_text: This Agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to its conflict-of-laws principles. The state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute or claim arising out of or in connection with this Agreement, and each Party submits to their jurisdiction.
